apiNamedQueryParameters.description: Full name of the patient exactly as recorded, for example Riya Demo Sharma. Ask the user for the full name; do not guess.

ApiNamedQuery.body2: SELECT Id, Name, PersonMobilePhone, RecordType.DeveloperName, (SELECT Id, Name, Program__c, Therapy__c, Status__c, Enrollment_Date__c, Insurance_Type__c, Prescriber_Name__c, (SELECT Name, Dispense_Date__c, Days_Supply__c, Pharmacy__c, Status__c FROM Dispenses__r ORDER BY Dispense_Date__c DESC LIMIT 20) FROM Program_Enrollments__r ORDER BY Enrollment_Date__c DESC LIMIT 5), (SELECT CaseNumber, Subject, Status, IsClosed, Origin, CreatedDate FROM Cases ORDER BY IsClosed, CreatedDate DESC LIMIT 20) FROM Account WHERE IsPersonAccount = true AND Name = :patientname ORDER BY CreatedDate LIMIT 5
ApiNamedQuery.description: Zenthera PSP demo: read-only patient profile by full name: mobile, enrollments with dispenses, and cases (IsClosed shows open/closed). Up to 5 rows: more than one = ambiguous name, none = not found.
